svg.text: PERSONAL FINANCE APP — PROBLEM-TO-CODE HARNESS (v2, ORCHESTRATED)
→ tests_generated → implementing → verifying → done (blocked at any point)
runs/<run-id>/ — result files + RUN.md (state, gate decisions)
single writer: only the orchestrator / launcher touches shared state

g.text: GATE-2 ADR accepted (data model, user scoping)
GATE-6 design mismatch → change the design?
GATE-7 merge worktrees · done with known gaps
automatic moves: backwards or to blocked only
flags[]: id kind blocking where text

svg.text: /orchestrate — orchestrator skill (main conversation · single writer · resumable via RUN.md)
red suite / coverage fail / "fix code" → back, max 2 retries
auto-done only with zero flags and work merged
tests-req.json · critic-req.json · implement-req.json · suite.json · coverage-req.json · design-req.json · RUN.md
worker ends with envelope → orchestrator writes it + runs validate_result.py → routes on verdict + blocking flags only → file is the next stage's input
Standalone launchers (/generate-tests, /implement, /verify, /design-frontend verification mode) still run one stage at a time and write the same result files.
